subject: youtube.channel.what_if
summary: «ماذا لو؟» is a speculative documentary channel using fact-grounded alternate history and near-future scenarios, with explicit separation between fact and hypothesis and Arabic retro-futurist visual language.

details.concept: speculative documentary / alternate history / near future
details.audience: Arabic 18–34 interested in history, technology and realistic speculation
details.narrative: shocking question -> fixed fact -> branching point -> three logical consequences -> closing question
pilot: Short: what if internet stopped in the Middle East for 24 hours?
6–8 min: what if oil had not been discovered in the Gulf?
Short/Long hybrid: Baghdad without cars — one day in 2045
